patterns.note: The primary content area is an expansive, full-width, irregular masonry-like grid of project images and diagrams, creating a continuous visual archive without traditional section breaks.
Minimalist, small, sans-serif typography is used exclusively for navigation and subtle project identification, maintaining a stark, understated aesthetic.
A stark white background serves as a dominant canvas, allowing the diverse and often vibrant colors within the project imagery to provide all visual interest and accents.

A fixed header bar remains visible at the top of the viewport, providing persistent navigation, while the extensive, image-heavy content scrolls continuously beneath it without any reveal animations or parallax effects.
The entire page functions as a single, unbroken visual stream of content, eschewing traditional section breaks, distinct content blocks, or descriptive text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains at the top of the viewport, providing persistent navigation. The main content area is a single, very long, scrollable canvas composed of a tightly packed, irregular grid of images and diagrams, which scrolls without any additional reveal animations or parallax effects.

The primary content display is an expansive, full-width grid that dynamically arranges project images and architectural drawings in a dense, mosaic-like fashion, filling the available space with minimal gutters and no explicit row or column structure.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, understated sans-serif for all text; navigation and firm name are slightly larger than project labels, maintaining a subtle hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: very dense, with minimal gutters between grid items, creating a continuous, packed visual field

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its radical approach to content display: the entire homepage is a single, infinitely scrolling, full-bleed collage of project images and architectural plans, presented without any descriptive text or traditional layout sections. It functions as an immersive, visual archive rather than a typical marketing page.
